title: Associate Graphic Designer (UK Process)
jobDescription:
Responsibilities Design and deliver creative assets including social media creatives, banners, presentations, and print materials. Collaborate closely with marketing, product, and content teams. Uphold brand consistency while exploring innovative design solutions. Manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Requirements Proficiency in Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design) is a must. Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and composition.
